packageRules.description: Merge everything except major automatically once CI passes. Patch is listed for the security patches that still open; the patch rule below skips the rest. Branches are only created on Mondays (top-level schedule); vulnerability alerts keep their own immediate schedule
Major updates can break APIs, so merge them by hand, and only open one after approval on the Dependency Dashboard: an open major takes the single open-PR slot and holds up every other update
Routine patch PRs would spend GitHub Actions minutes. Security patches still open because vulnerabilityAlerts.enabled=true is forced onto alert updates (GitHub alerts and OSV) and re-enables them

bun is pinned in mise.toml (CI), packageManager, and constraints.bun (the bun Renovate installs for bun.lock; the renovate-config manager bumps it). A bun.lock written by a newer bun than CI's can fail --frozen-lockfile

worker-configuration.d.ts records the workerd version bundled with wrangler, so CI's cf-typegen diff check fails until it is regenerated. The regeneration runs wrangler from node_modules, so a full bun install comes first: bun dedupe only installs when it removes a duplicate

customManagers.description: Update versions in bun workspaces.catalog in package.json
